title: Overview
text:
haxelementschema is the lightweight object format hax uses as a virtual dom representation before converting to real nodes. this companion spec hax-schema. where hax-schema explains full haxproperties contract for element authoring, site focuses specifically on payload objects used in demoschema, insertion, and conversion workflows.
core shape
haxelementschema an with shape:
{
  "tag": "my-tag",
 "properties": {
 "title": "example title"
 },
 "content": "<p>inner html content</p>",
 "eventname": "insert-element"
}

field reference


tag (required): html/custom-element tag name create.
properties (optional): key/value map of attributes and/or properties.
content string content assigned light dom.
eventname event metadata added by insertion pipelines.

text:

title: Virtual DOM Usage Points
text:
hax uses the haxelementschema object shape as a lightweight virtual dom payload during authoring operations. is passed around, transformed, and only materialized into actual nodes at insertion/render time. these are primary usage points in core:

virtual â conversion

haxelementtonode(haxschema) creates real from tag, properties, content.
reference: elements/utils/utils.js#l1207-l1314



dom conversion

nodetohaxelement(node, eventname) serializes existing haxelementschema.
reference: elements/utils/utils.js#l1500-l1718



prototype/factory creation

haxelementprototype(gizmo, content) returns { content, gizmo }.
reference: elements/hax-body/lib/hax-store.js#l5102-l5109



tray insertion pipeline

hax-tray resolves demoschema[0] or builds prototype dispatches it via hax-insert-content.
reference: elements/hax-body/lib/hax-tray.js#l1081-l1136



store pipeline

_haxstoreinsertcontent consumes detail.tag/content/properties converts to haxelementtonode for inline replace flows.
reference: elements/hax-body/lib/hax-store.js#l4067-l4192



keyboard shortcuts

shortcut map entries haxelementschema-style objects converted runtime.
references:

elements/hax-body/lib/hax-store.js#l2975-l2985
elements/hax-body/hax-body.js#l1852-l1878




duplicate workflow

haxduplicatenode ensure clean cloning.

globalthis.hax.add inserts using schema.demoschema[0] haxelementtonode.

title: Runtime Behavior & JSON Schema
text:
runtime conversion behavior in hax core, happens primarily two functions:

haxelementtonode(haxschema) â converts a schema object to real dom node.
nodetohaxelement(node, eventname) node object.

important be aware of:

camel-cased property keys are converted dash-cased attributes where needed.
true sets boolean attributes, false removes them.
object/array values set as properties when possible.
content becomes light (innerhtml) on conversion.
iframe is rewritten webview sandboxed environments.

json schema
this spec includes machine-readable json schema, hax-element-schema.schema.json, for validation and tooling support against the repository source.
why this exists

keep haxelementschema documentation focused easy discover.
provide canonical examples docs, tests, tooling.
offer shared reference systems that import/export element payloads.
